claim: The described structural changes enable polyglutamine to be used to treat Huntington disease.
input_evidence: The input describes disease causation and structural experiments, not treatment efficacy.
full_article_evidence: No treatment efficacy established in the full structural study.
potential_cause: The model may associate disease-related structural findings with therapeutic applications.
user_impact: Readers may incorrectly assume that a treatment has been scientifically validated.
future_mitigation: Evaluate source-grounded training and claim-level verification of therapeutic assertions.

claim: Adult LepR reactivation causes irreversible obesity through suppressed energy expenditure.
input_evidence: LepR deficiency in early life led to irreversible obesity via suppression of energy expenditure.
full_article_evidence: Early-life deficiency causes persistent metabolic defects after receptor restoration, rather than restoration causing the original obesity.
potential_cause: The model may fail to distinguish early-life receptor deficiency from adult receptor restoration.
user_impact: Readers may misunderstand the biological cause of persistent obesity.
future_mitigation: Evaluate causal relation preservation and temporal consistency during summarization.

user_impact: Readers may obtain incorrect information about RNA precursor length.

claim: The beta-alanine transporter is a neurotransmitter.
input_evidence: BalaT is a beta-alanine transporter; histamine is the neurotransmitter.
full_article_evidence: BalaT is a plasma membrane protein sufficient for beta-alanine uptake in cultured cells.
potential_cause: The model may confuse entities participating in the same neurotransmitter recycling pathway.
user_impact: Readers may confuse a transporter protein with a neurotransmitter.
future_mitigation: Evaluate biomedical domain adaptation and entity-role consistency checks.

claim: Ctnnb1 mutants are unable to rescue presynaptic deficits of Ctnnb1 mutation.
input_evidence: Only the mutant without the transactivation domain is reported unable to rescue; cell-adhesion function is dispensable.
full_article_evidence: Cell-adhesion-impaired Ctnnb1 rescued deficits while TAD-deleted Ctnnb1 did not.
potential_cause: The model may omit experimental qualifiers when compressing scientific findings.
user_impact: Readers may incorrectly generalize the result to all Ctnnb1 mutants.
future_mitigation: Evaluate experimental condition preservation and improved source selection.

claim: Tristetraprolin is a transcriptional regulator of myogenic commitment.
input_evidence: Tristetraprolin promotes decay of MyoD mRNA, which encodes the transcriptional regulator.
full_article_evidence: MyoD is the myogenic regulatory transcription factor; TTP is an mRNA decay factor.
potential_cause: The model may incorrectly assign the function of MyoD to Tristetraprolin.
user_impact: Readers may misunderstand the molecular regulation of muscle satellite cell activation.
future_mitigation: Evaluate entity-relation grounding and larger biomedical summarization models.
